subject: Your offer from Quanta Labs!
body:
Hi João,

Congratulations! We are pleased to offer you the Machine Learning Research Intern position for Summer 2027. Your offer letter is attached. Please sign and return it by Friday, October 30.

We're excited to have you on the team!

Marcus Lee
Recruiting, Quanta Labs

mock_response.summary: Offer received, respond by Fri Oct 30
